non_claims: Hydroxyl and methoxyl positions beyond the hypothesis scaffold are not resolved
Free aglycone versus an in-source aglycone ion of a conjugate is not decided by this rule
Flavanone versus chalcone is not resolved (Yang 2012)
Isoflavanones isomeric with the hypothesis (for example dihydrogenistein and naringenin) would give the same 1,3A- and 1,3B- formulas (by calculation) and are not excluded
Precursors at the other common negative adducts tried under adduct_ambiguous ([M+HCOO]-, [M+CH3COO]-, [M+Cl]-) are not described by the cited [M-H]- fragmentation

notes: Not measured pending the author's decision on the 1,3A- claim role: C7H3O4- is the generic 5,7-dihydroxy A-ring ion of flavonols and flavones too, and no cited source separates the weak 1,3B- from same-formula dihydroflavonol or isoflavanone ions.

competitors.note: aromadendrin shares C15H12O6 with eriodictyol, and its 1,3A- and 1,3B- would have the same formulas (C7H3O4-, C8H7O2-; by calculation); no cited negative-mode source contrasts the two classes (Yang 2012 p. 498 tested one flavanonol, dihydromyricetin); garbanzol shares C15H12O5 with naringenin
